esp32.detail: 4 pins wired; Added a 10 kΩ pull-up resistor from SCL to 3V3, as the datasheet requires. Added a 10 kΩ pull-up resistor from SDA to 3V3, as the datasheet requires. It shares the I2C bus (SDA D21, SCL D22) at address 0x4a. Added the max44009.py driver written from the datasheet.
Reports the illuminance set on the slider, bright and nearly dark: passes
